youtube.baslik: Why can't someone who reads and writes understand speech? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In pure word deafness, the person cannot understand speech, yet can read, write and recognize environmental sounds. In auditory agnosia, the person notices that a sound is there but cannot recognize what it is, for example whether it is a phone or a dog barking; these rare conditions show that the audiogram alone does not assess the brain.
